title: I loved flying helicopters in BF4, so I made a game about it
author: Col_CheeseCake
selftext:
This is the first time I’m actually showing my game to the world, so I’m a little nervous about posting it.  
As a solo dev, this game is my passion project, combining many things that I love, one of them being the flight mechanics from bf4 and bf6.

At some point I thought, “I should just make a game where flying the helicopter is the main thing.”

So... I did. Here we are many months later.

I made this gaming using antigravity as my AI coding partner for those wondering.  
I'm looking for feedback!
